claim: Local processing is approved as a permitted mechanism. Export of raw 15-minute data remains prohibited.
evidence: The container processed 15-minute data from twelve facilities and produced daily coefficients for three groups. It generated no individual series or persistent identifiers.
SolCentro reviewed the code and blocked network access. The container was deleted after execution.
The audit record includes the container image, parameters, data period, groups used and output hashes.
Héctor Molina: Yes, with controls: reviewed code, blocked network, data remaining at the provider, groups of at least five, inspected output and deletion of the temporary environment.
